source.title: Memristor-Based Spiking Neuromorphic Systems Toward Brain-Inspired Perception and Computing

confidence_rationale: A comprehensive device-physics review establishing that several of ARC-089's primitives have direct physical affordances in existing hardware -- memristance IS history-dependent deformation, threshold-switching memristors natively produce oscillation, multi-timescale integration and stochastic transition -- which supports the claim that the primitive vocabulary is physically legible rather than merely metaphorical. Confidence held to 0.55 by two things: the review addresses roughly four of the nine primitives and is silent on the three that carry REE's distinctive content, and the venue is a mid-tier MDPI review rather than a top-tier survey.
failure_signatures: The review demonstrates device-level physical affordances for persistent state, history-dependent deformation, oscillatory propagation, multi-timescale integration and stochastic transition, but reports NO device-level affordance for residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, or offline reintegration -- i.e. exactly the primitives that distinguish REE's vocabulary from a generic neuromorphic wishlist remain physically unaddressed.

Device variability is reported as a major unsolved problem -- cycle-to-cycle resistance scatter from stochastic filament growth, device-to-device variation in switching delay, threshold voltage and retention -- so 'the substrate instantiates stochastic transition' and 'the substrate is uncontrollably noisy' are not currently separable in hardware, and a primitive that is also a defect cannot by itself be an evaluation criterion.

Endurance ranges over four orders of magnitude across material systems (HfAlOx >200 cycles, TaOx >500 cycles, flexible VO2 >1e12 cycles), so substrate adequacy against a dynamics specification is material-specific rather than a property of the memristive class.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Threshold-switching memristors intrinsically exhibit oscillatory spiking, leaky integrate-and-fire behaviour, Hodgkin-Huxley-like depolarisation/hyperpolarisation/refractory dynamics, stochastic firing arising from atomic migration and thermal noise, and over twenty distinct spiking behaviours in VO2 devices -- generated by physical nonlinear switching rather than by algorithmic simulation, where an H-H timestep costs roughly 1200 floating-point operations.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the physical-legibility half of ARC-089 partially discharged in existing hardware. Memristance -- instantaneous resistance depending on the time integral of applied current -- IS history-dependent deformation of state as a device property, not as a simulated variable. Native oscillation, multi-timescale leaky integration and intrinsic stochastic transition map onto three more of the nine primitives. The review's explicit contrast between a device exhibiting H-H dynamics physically and a processor computing them at ~1200 FLOPs per timestep is the instantiate-versus-execute distinction ARC-089 asserts, demonstrated at device level.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Coverage is partial and the uncovered part is the load-bearing part. The review speaks to the substrate-neutral dynamical primitives that any neuromorphic programme would list, and says nothing about residue-as-action-landscape-deformation, the commitment latch, or offline reintegration -- the three that carry REE's actual architectural content. Reading this as 'ARC-089's vocabulary is hardware-realisable' overreaches; it supports only 'the vocabulary's physical-dynamics subset is hardware-realisable today'. There is also a scale gap: device-level spiking dynamics are several organisational levels below cognifold-level field dynamics, and nothing here shows the primitives compose upward.
mapping.source_context: Device-physics review of threshold-switching and drift memristors (VO2, NbOx, HfAlOx, TaOx, Ag-based) for spiking neuromorphic hardware; no cognitive or behavioural data.

confidence_components.notes: source_quality reflects a thorough and well-referenced review in a mid-tier MDPI venue. transfer_risk is the highest of the ARC-089 set because the inferential distance is largest -- nanoscale device switching to cognifold field dynamics spans several organisational levels, and the review offers no evidence that the primitives compose across them.
